title: America Has 66,000 Storage Facilities—More Than Major Chains
hook: America has 66,000 storage facilities—more than its biggest chains combined.
closing: Our towns built more space for stuff than storefronts.
question: How much stuff do you store?

segments.say: Self-storage reached 66 thousand facilities, exceeding every listed restaurant and coffee chain.
Storage facilities make up 57 percent of this combined location count.
Storage facilities reached 66 thousand after multiplying tenfold since the earliest point.
